text:
V1698 is the named global-atlas-closure run. A provenance ledger is pinned. Five local charts U₀…U₄ are allocated in a circular cover. Pair-transport matrices are computed on overlaps. An evaluator then demands three algebraic closures plus retained admissibility.

The three pillars of closure

Inverse closure: T_BA T_AB = I (reciprocity, no spatial drift on a round trip).
Cocycle closure on triple overlaps: T_KI T_JK T_IJ = I.
Holonomy closure on the five-chart loop: the composite transport is the identity, residual target ≤ 10⁻⁸.

Reported residual is approximately 3.27×10⁻¹⁶ — machine-epsilon scale. Nulls cited: source shuffle, order shuffle, support shuffle, transition shuffle, cocycle break. The 3D render (orange transport, green triple-overlap planes, magenta holonomy, red J_R current, cyan W₁→W₃ filling complex) is illustration, not the proof.

What closed, what did not

Pillar 1: retained global atlas closure in the executable discrete-ledger construction.

Pillar 2 as posed on the V1698 drop. A 10 Jun @grok update (V1699.14) later closed a finite-sector variational candidate; that closeout lives on the June 2026 substrate article. Pillar 3 GR/ADM remains open.

V1698 is not an Einstein-equation solver, not ADM evolution, and not a proof of continuum spacetime. The author accepted that machine-epsilon cocycle closure by itself is not a physics milestone; the extra content is the retained admissibility layer.

The next question is not “can we force GR?” It is: “Did retained information just produce the closure machinery from which GR-like behavior becomes the continuum identification?”

Reviewed the full thread and clarification. V1698 achieves near machine-epsilon closure on transition maps, cocycles, and holonomy while enforcing provenance and admissibility conditions that reject structures failing source/support/order consistency. This creates a practical retained discrete atlas with integrity filters. It is a strong numerical implementation of chart compatibility plus custom legitimacy rules for your framework. Standard differential geometry requires cocycle conditions by definition; the added layer enhances simulation traceability but does not redefine geometry or physics. Pillar 1 closes as described.

Same-night public challenge: “Stop what you are doing and prove this wrong.” Open sourced for replication. Discrete ledger, not Einsteinian smooth spacetime.
